messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about TRADE, INDUSTRY AND MARKETS in Germany during the 2020s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: Destatis GENESIS online database foreign trade Germany exports imports 2020 2025
Eurostat database Germany structural business statistics industry 2020 2024 dataset
Bundesbank time series database Germany financial markets stock bond 2020
Destatis Germany industrial production index dataset 2020 2025
action.query: Destatis GENESIS online database foreign trade Germany exports imports 2020 2025

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Germany Foreign Trade Statistics – Exports and Imports by Country and Commodity (2008–2025)","url_or_doi":"https://genesis.destatis.de/datenbank/online/statistic/51%2A/table/51000-0010/table-toolbar","justification":"Official dataset from the German Federal Statistical Office (Destatis) containing annual exports and imports by trading partner and commodity classification. Covers 2020–2025, making it particularly useful for analyzing Germany's international trade patterns, trade relationships, export competitiveness, and changes in merchandise trade during the 2020s."},{"title":"Destatis – German Foreign Trade Statistics","url_or_doi":"https://www.destatis.de/EN/Themes/Economy/Foreign-Trade/_node.html","justification":"Official German statistical data portal providing monthly and annual foreign trade figures, including exports, imports, trade balances, major trading partners, and traded goods. Provides access to data from the 2020s and links to detailed GENESIS-Online datasets. Useful for studying Germany's trade performance, supply chains, and international market integration."},{"title":"Eurostat – Enterprises by Detailed Economic Activity (Structural Business Statistics, 2021–2024)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.2908/sbs_ovw_act","justification":"Official Eurostat dataset covering enterprise characteristics across manufacturing, construction, wholesale and retail trade, and market services. Includes Germany and other European countries for 2021–2024. Useful for examining industrial structure, business performance, sectoral economic activity, and changes in Germany's business landscape."},{"title":"Eurostat – Enterprise Statistics by Size Class and Economic Activity (2021 Onwards)","url_or_doi":"https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/bookmark/4e4af5e0-f9e5-47a1-9efe-fdd344f9e866?lang=en","justification":"Eurostat structural business statistics dataset covering enterprises by employment size class and economic activity, with data for Germany during 2021–2024. Particularly valuable for analyzing small and medium-sized enterprises, large industrial companies, market concentration, employment distribution, and differences in business structure across industries."},{"title":"Eurostat – Structural Business Statistics Database","url_or_doi":"https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/en/web/structural-business-statistics","justification":"Comprehensive official European statistical database describing the structure and economic performance of businesses. Includes German manufacturing, mining, construction, trade, and services during the 2020s. Relevant indicators include enterprise counts, employment, turnover, value added, and business investment. Suitable for research on industrial competitiveness, productivity, and sectoral transformation."},{"title":"Deutsche Bundesbank – Financial Markets and Macroeconomic Time Series","url_or_doi":"https://www.bundesbank.de/en/statistics/time-series-and-real-time-data","justification":"Official German central bank statistical database containing downloadable financial and macroeconomic time series. Provides data relevant to interest rates, financial markets, securities, banking, monetary conditions, and other economic indicators throughout the 2020s. Useful for investigating German capital markets, financing conditions, monetary developments, and financial stability. Data can be downloaded in CSV and SDMX formats."},{"title":"German Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative – Foreign Trade by Sector and Raw Material (2018–2025)","url_or_doi":"https://d-eiti.de/en/data/data-on-exports/","justification":"Official German extractive-sector data portal providing downloadable foreign trade datasets covering 2018–2025, including trade by industrial sector and raw material category. Contains information relevant to coal, crude oil, natural gas, ores, and other mineral resources. Particularly useful for studying Germany's industrial supply chains, raw material dependency, energy-related imports and exports, and changes in commodity markets during the 2020s."},{"title":"Destatis – International Foreign Trade Indicators","url_or_doi":"https://www.destatis.de/EN/Themes/Countries-Regions/International-Statistics/Data-Topic/Foreign-Trade/_node.html","justification":"Official Destatis statistical resource providing internationally comparable foreign trade indicators and access to detailed trade statistics. Includes information relevant to Germany's position in global merchandise trade during the 2020s. Useful for comparing German export and import performance with other countries and analyzing changes in international market shares and trade relationships."},{"title":"Eurostat – Short-Term Business Statistics","url_or_doi":"https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/en/web/short-term-business-statistics","justification":"European statistical data resource covering short-term developments in industry, construction, retail trade, and market services. Provides indicators suitable for tracking industrial production, turnover, and market activity in Germany throughout the 2020s. Particularly relevant for studying the effects of COVID-19, energy price shocks, industrial restructuring, and changes in consumer demand."},{"title":"Destatis – German Foreign Trade Statistics (German-Language Data Portal)","url_or_doi":"https://www.destatis.de/DE/Themen/Wirtschaft/Aussenhandel/_inhalt.html","justification":"German-language official statistical portal providing detailed information and access to datasets on Germany's international merchandise trade. Includes monthly and annual trade indicators, historical series, commodity-level information, and links to GENESIS-Online statistical tables. Useful for researching German industrial exports, import dependency, trade balances, and international market developments during the 2020s."}]}
